rendered: The premise does not match the paper. The authors did not pick the lower end of their range as the optimum. The ligand concentration was tuned across the range 0 to 120 μM[1], and the optimum was higher. The CD intensity reached its maximum at 165 μM[2], and the authors state that 165 μM was chosen as the optimized condition[3] for all subsequent experiments. Higher concentrations gave little change: 225 μM resulted in only marginal changes in the CD signal.[4] The CD signal also decreased slightly above the maximum. The optimum condition also gave the best redispersion stability, since with the 165 μM 4-MPBA-derived BA@L-HGNRs showing[5] exceptional spectral stability during the monitoring. So the document gives 165 μM[6], not 120 μM[7], as the optimal concentration, and the stated reasons are the maximum CD response, the plateau above it, and the redispersion stability.
